introduction.en: A researcher used Claude Code to assemble tax-preparation inputs from scattered records.
introduction.zh: 一位研究者用 Claude Code 将分散资料汇总为报税准备材料。

method.en: Chris Blattman built Claude Code skills to find Gmail tax attachments, extract figures and track missing documents. A second workflow reconciled donations, receipts and card statements.
method.zh: Chris Blattman自建Claude Code技能，搜集Gmail税务附件、提取数字并追踪缺件；另一流程整合捐赠表、收据和信用卡账单。

method.en: Outputs included deduction spreadsheets and Schedule C for consulting income. He manually identified medical and childcare items and entered the final tax software himself.
method.zh: 输出包括扣除项目表和咨询收入Schedule C；医疗、托育项目由本人识别，最终报税软件也由本人录入。

outcome.en: He describes about three hours of work compared with an approximately $1,000 accountant option; sorting, filtering and CSV handling worked better than the remaining manual categories.
outcome.zh: 他描述用时约三小时，并与约1,000美元会计服务作比较；排序、筛选和CSV处理较顺利，部分分类仍需人工。

notes.en: The source advises checking privacy terms: reading local files may send their contents to Anthropic. It specifically cautions against including SSNs or bank-account numbers.
notes.zh: 源站要求先查隐私说明：读取本地文件可能将内容发送给Anthropic，特别提醒不要纳入社保号或银行账号。
